changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwreferralrequests AS SELECT rr.id, rr.patient_id, rr.encounter_id, rr.from_facility_id, rr.to_facility_id, rr.from_department_id, rr.to_department_id, rr.referral_type, rr.referral_reason, rr.priority, rr.status, rr.rejected_date, rr.rejected_by, rr.reject_reason, rr.accepted_date, rr.accepted_by, rr.created_date, rr.created_by, rr.last_modified_by, rr.last_modified_date, rr.appointment_id FROM public.referral_requests rr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwreferralrequests TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwreferralrequests FROM report_user;
